scope: Compact scalar review of fixed-frequency hydrogen cross-section preparation. No atmosphere, stellar spectra, frequency tables, full model states or photon-flux arrays are published.
design: Only unscaled hydrogenic cross sections at constructor-fixed frequencies are prepared. Temperature-dependent Milne factors, populations, electrons, photon flux and future topoff factors remain dynamic.

Strong-reference frequency identity selects a prepared array. General frequency arguments, tracers and replaced grids use the original formula. Receiver frequency, photon flux and cross section are concatenated in the same actual group order.
The generic public H photon-receiver API delegates to the same private formula used by the prepared Solar path; no physics closure or public argument changed.

kernel_context.input_state: Actual supplied eight-cell temperature, H populations, proton/electron densities; not a complete root.
kernel_context.photons: Synthetic signed per-frequency event flux; permitted for overlap corrections. Not a measured stellar field.
kernel_context.implementation_scope: The isolated prototype changes only the cross-section expression in the frozen H methods. The promoted core is checked separately through the final tests and complete composition-target comparisons.

kernel_parity.error_definition: Maximum absolute difference divided by maximum absolute reference value, separately for each output or input-gradient block.
kernel_parity.component_comparison_mask: Absolute log-input-gradient component exceeds 1e-12 times the largest component in its input block.

measured_kernel_cost.interpretation: Compilation is substantially reduced. These sampled warmed runtimes do not establish general runtime acceleration; the sampled VJP runtime increases slightly. Allocation numbers are compiled-kernel temporary bytes, not whole-application memory.

complete_composition_target_parity.context: Same supplied eight-cell state, boundaries and grids, comparing old9dda and new6f562804 source. Cases: shared continuum with isolated H lines; 49 H lines with three selected FeII overlaps. This is a full composition-target/heat evaluation, not a re-solved atmosphere.
complete_composition_target_parity.criterion: Maximum target-log-coordinate change <1e-10, physical-valid unchanged; heat cancellation is reported against both gross and net denominators, not hidden in the target criterion.

tests.scope: Four new cache cases plus 24 existing H/IR integration regressions. New cases check complete composition with groups retained/removed, temperature/population/flux JVP and VJP, and generic/shifted frequency JVP against central differences.
tests.lint: Changed files pass ruff with the three pre-existing Solar E731 diagnostics excluded; git diff --check passes.

limits: Parity is measured at the named states and grids; it is not a proof for every atom, atmosphere or parameter value.
No complete-root implicit gradient, NUTS domain, physical adequacy or agreement with Cloudy is certified here.
No bound-free threshold-crossing differentiability claim is made.
The later whole-residual transpose uses additional source changes since64b and cannot attribute all performance changes to this cache.
authoring_verification: Recomputed kernel array norms, weak flux-gradient comparison, full composition-target and heat differences, XML results, input and committed-source hashes before record creation. MCEG itself checks record/source integrity; it does not rerun these scientific calculations.
